game.title: Metro 2033 Redux
game.blurb: Post-apocalyptic first-person shooter from 4A Games (RAWG also lists Deep Silver and Fishlabs Entertainment), released 2014-08-25. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Finding the truth, becoming a true ranger, and one hidden achievement. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Places and Good Deeds
chapters.summary: Feats on the named levels: CURSED STATION, OUTPOST, FRONTLINE, BLACK STATION, HUNTER and DEPOT, plus rescuing the Reds and helping the poor.

chapters.title: Diary Pages, Stashes and Trade
chapters.summary: Artyom's 51 hidden diary pages, the Ranger stashes in Dead City, locked safe boxes, weapon shop deals and saving military-grade rounds.

chapters.title: Mutants
chapters.summary: Hunting lurkers, nosalises, watchmen, demons, amoebas, spiders and librarians.

chapters.title: Survival and Spartan Modes
chapters.summary: Finishing the game in Survival Mode and in Spartan Mode.

chapters.title: Combat, Stealth and Gear
chapters.summary: Weapon kill counts, headshots, stealth and close combat, traps, medkits, the gas mask and radiation.

collectibles.name: Demolitionist
collectibles.where: Blow up the tunnel and airlock at CURSED STATION.

collectibles.name: DJ Artyom
collectibles.where: On the level OUTPOST reach the radio tower and broadcast the commander's message.

collectibles.name: Generous
collectibles.where: Help the poor, a coin for the kid, medicine for the sick. You help everyone you see.

collectibles.name: Hedge-hopper
collectibles.where: On the level FRONTLINE kill all of the enemy Red Army and Fascist Soldiers.

collectibles.name: Invisible man
collectibles.where: Complete FRONTLINE level without killing anyone.

collectibles.name: Manhattan Project
collectibles.where: Spend 60 seconds in a Radiation Hotspot.

collectibles.name: Toast!
collectibles.where: Hidden on Steam: the unlock condition is secret. Most likely tied to story progress, so it is spoiler-guarded.

collectibles.name: Merciful
collectibles.where: Complete the level BLACK STATION without killing or knocking out any enemies.

collectibles.name: Blogger
collectibles.where: Complete all 51 of Artyom's hidden Diary pages.

collectibles.name: Quick Draw
collectibles.where: On the level HUNTER kill the nosalises before they break through the ventilation grilles.

collectibles.name: Raider
collectibles.where: On the level DEPOT silently kill the first guard and break into the Fascist station unnoticed.

collectibles.name: Ranger
collectibles.where: Find all Ranger stashes in Dead City.

collectibles.name: Rescue Ranger
collectibles.where: Save a group of Reds from Fascist captivity.

collectibles.name: Slice & Dice
collectibles.where: Kill 30 human enemies in close combat.

collectibles.name: Marksman
collectibles.where: Kill 15 human enemies with Headshots from at least 30 meters' distance.

collectibles.name: Spartan 2033
collectibles.where: Complete the game in Spartan Mode.

collectibles.name: Stunning
collectibles.where: Knock 30 human enemies out in close combat.

collectibles.name: Survivor 2033
collectibles.where: Complete the game in Survival Mode.

collectibles.name: Tank
collectibles.where: Kill 10 Enemies in a row without taking any damage.

collectibles.name: If it's hostile, you kill it.
Weaponsmith
collectibles.where: Kill at least one enemy with each weapon available in the game

collectibles.name: Wheeler-Dealer
collectibles.where: Exchange 500 Military-Grade 5.45 rounds at Exchange kiosks.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry: slug "metro-redux", named "Metro 2033 Redux" (id 3603); RAWG keeps the 2010 "Metro 2033" separately (id 29028). Steam app 286690 is the Redux itself: its schema is named "Project Redux" (an internal codename) and the store list confirms "Metro 2033 Redux"; no app for the original 2010 release was found in the store list. StrategyWiki has nothing under "Metro 2033 Redux" or "Metro Redux"; the guide is under "Metro 2033", which covers the original 2010 release (its categories are 2010, Windows and Xbox 360). It is at completion stage 0: Prologue and Chapter 1 "Let the Journey Begin" to Chapter 7 "Tower" are written (about 1,600 to 12,000 characters each), as are Achievements and Table of Contents, but the Walkthrough index, Gameplay, Controls, Enemies, Equipment, Weapons and Cheats pages are linked but not written. Because it is stage 0 and covers the original release, it was not used. metrovideogame.fandom.com redirects "Metro 2033" to a disambiguation page; "Metro 2033 (Video Game)" was used instead (about 116 linked articles); "Metro 2033 Redux" also exists there but is short (7 links). Names only were looked at, nothing copied. 1 of 49 Steam achievements is hidden ("Toast!") and sits in the main story chapter. The named levels come from the achievement descriptions; which StrategyWiki chapter each level belongs to is not in the data, so level feats are grouped together.
